violations.detail: Pin U6.RF_OUT is connected to 3 distinct nets — LO_U6_U11, LO_U6_U3, LO_U6_U4 — types: clock. A single pin is one electrical node, so these nets are shorted together. If this is a differential pair (_P/_N) tied to one off-page connector pin, give each polarity its own connector pin.

Power/ground rail 'GND' has 14 endpoints but none of the reference designators look like a driver (PWR*, REG*, LDO*, CONN*). Verify a supply source is actually connected.
Power net 'VCC' has no capacitor-class reference (C*) attached — add bulk + bypass decoupling.

Design has 15 distinct clock domains (LO_U6_U11, LO_U6_U3, LO_U6_U4, LO_U7_U11, LO_U7_U3, LO_U7_U4, LO_U8_U11, LO_U8_U3, LO_U8_U4, LO_Y1_U11, LO_Y1_U3, LO_Y1_U4, LO_Y2_U11, LO_Y2_U3, LO_Y2_U4) but no CDC synchroniser / FIFO / dual-port cell is declared in the BOM. Metastability risk unless RTL adds 2FF synchronisers at every crossing.
